caption:
जन्म कुंडली बनाते समय आपकी जानकारी आपके फोन से बाहर नहीं जाती।

RishtaPatra brings three products: biodata maker · Rishta Connect (matchmaking) · Janam Kundali (free).

When you use our astrology tool, Janam Kundali is computed client-side (the astrology engine runs in the browser); no request carries birth data.

Also in the biodata maker, every detail, photo and imported resume is processed in the browser and saved only on the device; an account is optional.

Disclaimer: Kundali details are indicative; consult your pandit.

Visit rishtapatra.com to build your biodata or calculate your free Janam Kundali.
